result: Unicode-aware deterministic matching, evaluation metrics, tiered RxNorm candidate lineage, optional LanceDB retrieval, explainable abstention, and append-only pending-review adjudication are implemented without clinical-equivalence or automatic-acceptance claims.

Cross-jurisdiction enforcement, fail-closed release evidence, append-only adjudication, mutation scope, benchmark honesty, and clinical-safety boundaries are approved for hosted merge and archival.
All hosted checks, Linux mutation testing, and Codecov passed before merge; the reviewed v0.5 implementation track is archived.
